verdict.rationale: Unstructured is built for batch processing many documents. Workflows pull whole sets of files from source connectors (Azure Blob, Box, Confluence, Databricks Volumes) to destinations. Jobs process local files in bulk and let you inspect any files that failed. The quickstart scripts handle multiple files in a directory, and all of this is scriptable via the SDK, REST, or MCP. Missing for 10: bulk management operations on workflows and jobs (e.g., batch update or delete), documented concurrency and throughput limits for large batches, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
